title: Incident-detection drill report
description: The evidence that a synthetic incident was injected at a known instant and detected, with the time to detect measured rather than asserted. This schema holds the shape only: JSON Schema cannot subtract timestamps or compare numbers across fields, so tooling/practice_ci/drill_check.py checks mttdMs, scaledMttdMs, withinObjective and notified against the timestamps (spec/drill-report/README.md).

target.description: What the incident was injected into. Opaque to this contract.

injectedAt.description: The instant the synthetic incident began.

detectedAt.description: The instant the detector first reported it.

mttdMs.description: Measured time to detect in milliseconds: detectedAt minus injectedAt, exactly.

probeIntervalMs.description: The interval between probes in the drill.

threshold.description: Consecutive failed probes before the detector reports.

productionIntervalMs.description: The probe interval the projection is made for.

scaledMttdMs.description: mttdMs projected to productionIntervalMs: mttdMs * productionIntervalMs / probeIntervalMs, rounded down.

objectiveMs.description: The time to detect the objective allows, judged against scaledMttdMs.

withinObjective.description: True exactly when scaledMttdMs is at most objectiveMs.

notifiedAt.description: The instant a person or channel was told. Optional.

notifiedBy.description: What told them. Optional, opaque to this contract.

notified.description: True exactly when both notifiedAt and notifiedBy are present. A detection-only drill never reads as a notification.

commit.description: The commit the drill ran at, so a reader can reproduce it.

command.description: The command that ran the drill.

time.description: UTC (RFC 3339 with the Z offset), a real calendar date and time, so that subtraction is unambiguous.
